role: The result of a ray trace against the world: which block face or entity a ray hit, and where. Used by block targeting, projectiles, the explosion's block-density walk and mob AI.

members.name: typeOfHit
members.note: rt_mop.type carries the block form (0..5 face or RT_MISS); the ENTITY form is resolved inline by each caller, no shared C field

members.name: entityHit
members.note: entity ray hits are resolved per caller in the AI files; no shared C struct carries them; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: MovingObjectPosition
members.note: the block-form ctor's fields are filled into an rt_mop by the ray walk

members.name: MovingObjectPosition
members.note: the boolean is the MISS/BLOCK branch, rt_mop.type's RT_MISS

members.name: MovingObjectType
members.note: MISS/BLOCK/ENTITY as ints: RT_MISS or 0..5 for block faces; entity hits carry no enum

notes: raytrace.h documents the mapping (MovingObjectPosition's block form). Exercised by the explosion gate (getBlockDensity's ray) and by block targeting in the survival replay recordings. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: The entity form (ctor (Entity)V / (Entity,Vec3)V and field entityHit): every native caller that ray-traces against entities resolves the hit inline, no shared MovingObjectPosition port.
